LanguageData.DMS_Wetware.label: wetware gestation
LanguageData.DMS_Wetware.description: A special directed development gene designed to make an embryo mutate and develop in a predetermined way during gestation, growing into a biological wetware computer compatible with mechanical circuitry.\n\nThe Colonial Fleet chose to seal this technology rather than destroy it, and has banned its circulation and use outright. When it comes to biomatroid production on settled worlds, the fleet acts directly - and makes no distinction between whoever runs the production line and whoever sold the files.
